author: Romain Racamier-Lafon <romain.racamier@gmail.com>
description: Comparison of different TypeScript result pattern libraries
name: ts-result-comparison

scripts.bench: hyperfine "bun src/resultx.ts" "bun src/vanilla-throw.ts" "bun src/vanilla-object.ts" "bun src/fluent-type-results.ts" "bun src/typescript-result.ts" "bun src/neverthrow.ts" "bun src/byethrow.ts"
scripts.bench:node: hyperfine "node dist/resultx.js" "node dist/vanilla-throw.js" "node dist/vanilla-object.js" "node dist/fluent-type-results.js" "node dist/typescript-result.js" "node dist/neverthrow.js" "node dist/byethrow.js" && echo bench:node success
scripts.check: repo-check && pnpm check:tsc && pnpm build && pnpm check:once && echo check success
